Welcome to Luxe by Lilailah

A love of sparkle.

Luxe by Lilailah is a UK-based online boutique preparing a children’s collection of ball gowns and pageant dresses for girls aged 5–14, alongside tiaras, crowns and a separate Sweet Sixteen collection.

Our style is romantic and elegant, with soft pinks, shimmering details and those little finishing touches that make a look feel special.

We’re getting ready to launch. Follow along as we introduce our collections and share what’s coming next.
